subject: Learning Methods
title: Motivation Follows Action
description: A fast breakdown of Motivation Follows Action for builders.

hook.text: Most people wait for motivation to start. Research shows the opposite: action creates motivation, not the other way.

buildup.text: The behavioral activation model from therapy shows that doing the activity generates the positive emotion to continue.

discovery.text: Newton's first law applies psychologically: starting requires force, but once moving, momentum maintains itself.

twist.text: If you only study when motivated, you study sporadically. If you study regardless, motivation appears within minutes.

climax.text: Don't wait to feel motivated. Sit down, open the book, read one page. Motivation will arrive while you're already.

punchline.text: Start without motivation. It will arrive while you work.

quiz.question: Why does the behavioral activation model say action comes before motivation?
options: Motivation is a myth created by self-help authors
Doing the activity generates the positive emotion to continue
The brain cannot feel motivation until muscles are activated
